desc:
A high-output energy-storage W-Engine, designed for stronger bursts of instantaneous power.
The top-liked comment on a W-Engine review ranking claimed that dripping blood into the W-Engine could further enhance its performance. This has been confirmed to be a rumor. Do not imitate.
desc2: Equip to increase Armorer Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: A special W-Engine developed by the Flint family.
